findings.statement: At F_101, S(1,3,41)=0 and R=P+T, but the all-positive lift P+T+R=2R is finite and not the identity.
findings.consequence: x-only vanishing cannot select signs, certify subgroup membership, or establish a group relation.

findings.statement: S(1,3,41)=4545=45*101, while S(1,3,41)+1=4546=1 mod 101; the constant monomial remains present.
findings.consequence: same support does not imply the planted modular root or a group oracle.

findings.statement: For a=2,b=3, 4*a^3+27*b^2=275=5^2*11, so p=5 and p=11 are singular finite specializations of the formal source.
findings.consequence: finite curve predicates must be bound and checked before any group interpretation.

findings.statement: No final S exists from a scientific cell. For a future finite p, denominator invertibility and degree/leading-coefficient/pivot/ideal-span preservation are unverified.
findings.consequence: a symbolic delta_star cannot yet be transferred to a finite modular root claim.

findings.statement: Ryan Lemma 7 assumes Heuristics 1 and 2, shared-root and suitability properties, proportional coefficient substitution, sufficiently large p, a strict epsilon margin, and a log-p growth condition.
findings.consequence: finite interpolation and source compatibility do not certify theorem applicability.

findings.statement: All symbolic phases and whole-call cgroup accounting are present prospectively; phase CPU excludes child processes, no call ran, and reduction/extraction are absent.

theorem_obligations.name: shared_root_and_suitability
theorem_obligations.acceptance: Every specialized shift shares the root modulo p^mu and the resulting ordered set is suitable for the determinant formula.

theorem_obligations.name: heuristic_1_zero_dimensionality
theorem_obligations.acceptance: Recovered integer polynomials have a zero-dimensional variety on the tested finite instance.

theorem_obligations.name: heuristic_2_polynomial_statistics
theorem_obligations.acceptance: The dimension, coordinate-sum and leading-coefficient functions satisfy the required global polynomial and degree conditions; interpolation samples alone are not proof.

theorem_obligations.name: coefficient_scaling_and_height
theorem_obligations.acceptance: Every substituted value has the proportional-to-p or explicitly modelled height required by the Lemma 7 numerator.

theorem_obligations.name: large_p_and_growth
theorem_obligations.acceptance: The finite family satisfies sufficiently-large-p and the explicit log-p domination condition with delta below the strict epsilon margin.

theorem_obligations.name: root_recovery
theorem_obligations.acceptance: Enough independent integer equations are recovered and exact extraction returns bounded candidates that pass polynomial and group verification.
